definitions: To remain alert and focused on a task or objective.
To pay close attention to what is happening and be prepared for any changes.
examples: You need to keep your eye on the ball if you want to succeed in this project.
It's important to keep your eye on the ball during negotiations.
The coach told the team to keep their eye on the ball and not get distracted.
lemma: keep your eye on the ball
source: keep your eye on the ball
